Decode bounded fish behavioural states under an explicit Gaussian HMM

Source: R/gaussian-hmm-states.R
aqt_hmm_decode.Rd

Uses caller-specified (NOT learned) Gaussian state means and standard deviations, an initial distribution and a row-stochastic transition matrix. Forward-backward yields observation-conditional posterior state probabilities; Viterbi yields a single descriptive state sequence. Different fish, sessions, cameras and tanks are never joined. Missing observations, invalid observed flags and time gaps above max_gap_s break the Markov chain. Short valid runs remain explicitly unclassified. State names do not establish fish stress, welfare, preference or causal responses. No treatment p-values or uncertainty calibration are supplied.

Usage

aqt_hmm_decode(
  data,
  outcome = "speed",
  state_means,
  state_sds,
  transition,
  initial = NULL,
  state_labels = NULL,
  max_gap_s = 0.5,
  min_segment = 3L
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with session_id,camera_id,track_id,time_s and a numeric outcome. Optional observed,tank_id,treatment are preserved.

outcome

Name of observed numeric measure (default speed).

state_means

Strictly increasing externally justified state means.

state_sds

Positive Gaussian SD per state.

transition

K-by-K row-stochastic transition probabilities.

initial

Optional initial probability vector; equal by default.

state_labels

Optional distinct nonempty descriptive names.

max_gap_s

Maximum elapsed time to join adjacent samples.

min_segment

Minimum consecutive observed samples to decode.

Value

aqt_hmm_states with posterior hmm_p1..hmm_pK, Viterbi state, entropy, explicit missingness, segments and model/likelihood metadata.
